shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && cat AGENTS.md && git log --oneline | head && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

head -60 .claude/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && cat .claude/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40 && ls node_modules | head -40 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null
npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -5 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n -i -A 30 'required setup\|## Install\|## Usage' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components | tr '\n' ' '
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components; for c in PasswordInput Checkbox; do echo "===== $c"; cat $D/$c.md 2>/dev/null || ls $D | grep -i $c; done

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components; for c in TextInput Card; do echo "===== $c"; grep -n -A 60 -i '## Properties\|### Properties\|^## Props\|| Name' $D/$c.md 2>/dev/null | head -90 || ls $D | grep -i $c; done

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components; for c in Button Text Flex; do echo "===== $c"; grep -n -B2 -A 40 -i '^## Properties\|^### Properties\|^## Props' $D/$c.md 2>/dev/null | head -70 || ls $D | grep -i $c; done

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; ls $D/components/controls $D/guides; echo ----; grep -n -i 'Provider\|ThemeProvider' $D/guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -30; echo ----; grep -n -B2 -A 25 '## Properties' $D/components/controls/TextInput.md | head -60; echo ----; grep -n -B2 -A 30 '## Properties' $D/components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -50

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; grep -n -i -A 12 'Flex\b' $D/guides/layout.md | grep -n 'direction\|gap\|alignItems\|justifyContent\|^.*Box' | head -20; echo ----; grep -n -A 30 -i '^## Provider\|^### Provider\|<Provider' $D/guides/theming.md | head -60; echo ----; grep -o 'export \* from [^;]*Provider[^;]*\|export {[^}]*Provider[^}]*}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; sed -n 40,100p $D/guides/layout.md; echo ----; sed -n 126,140p $D/components/controls/TextInput.md; echo ----; sed -n 1,46p $D/components/Card.md | grep -n 'type\|view\|theme\|size' | head -20

E=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n 'gap\|SpacingToken\|type BoxProps\|^ *p[xy]\?\?:\|^ *m[xy]\?\?:' $E/layout/Box/Box.d.ts $E/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $E/layout/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ----; grep -rn 'TEXT_VARIANTS\|header-1\|subheader-1' $E/Text/*.d.ts $E/Text/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8

sed -n 100,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | grep -E '^\s+[a-zA-Z]+\??:' | head -60; echo ----; grep -n 'SpacingValue\b *=' -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | head; echo ----; grep -n 'lang\b\|"ru"\|Lang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/i18n.md | head -8

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; grep -n 'color?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -3; grep -n 'COLOR\|=' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -5
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15 && git status --short
rm -rf dist && sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/' index.html && grep -n 'gravity' package.json && git status --short
